a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs about 3 storm-free rounds, so we'd both almost surely die. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after so you can rebuild the reserve and take 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
